about_the_game:
Stars of Icarus is the latest starship combat game from the team behind Guns of Icarus. In the outer reaches of space, teamwork is all you can rely on. Form a ragtag crew with friends and strangers to face off against each other in this nail-biting online PvP ship-based combat game. Choose your ship, join your squadron, customize your loadout, and become the Frontier’s most lethal crew. Will you master the stars or go out in a blaze of glory?

Fly Together or Fail Alone

With six ships to choose from and over 25 variations of fleet formations, will you scout ahead with high-speed attacks in the solo fighters, provide mission-critical fire support in the two-seater corvettes or bring in the big guns with a three-manned frigate? Fail to prepare, prepare to fail. In every pre-game lobby, decide the composition of your squadron and tailor your ship’s loadout to gain the upper hand in your battles. 

All Hands on Deck

Stars of Icarus is all about teamwork - when the ship goes down, the crew goes down with it. Customize your character, equip the right tools for your role, and assemble your crew of five and jump into a community server for an old school multiplayer experience! Whether you take responsibility for navigating the cosmic fog, manning the cannons to wipe out enemy ships, or ensuring the shields and engines hold – your team is relying on you.

We’re All Built Different

Create your own unique character, decorate your ship and reap the rewards of your skirmishes with a wide range of costumes and cosmetic options in the in-game store. These items are cosmetic only - you will have access to all the ships, tools, and weapons from the very beginning. There is no pay-to-win in Stars of Icarus.

We’re supporting players fully in enjoying Stars of Icarus their own way – whether that’s jumping into competitive modes or kicking back for the evening to hang out with friends in custom lobbies and servers.

Tales From the Space Bar

Tell tales of your narrow escape from enemy fire, drifting through asteroid fields with half an engine and a broken antenna. Each arena adds their own twists and turns to your engagements with dynamic environments. Use your experience to your advantage or fall victim to their unforgiving nature.

Revival of an Epic Franchise

Stars of Icarus is the continuation of our decade-long legacy. Guns of Icarus Online, pioneered the crew-based PvP airship experience back in 2012. Stars is an homage to the game and community that put us on the map. We’re excited for this next chapter and we look forward to seeing you in the stars.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 9600K, AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660, AMD Radeon RX 5600, or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

reviews:
“As someone who’s played a lot of Guns of Icarus Online and TIE Fighter and read the X-Wing novels, this truly is more of that adrenaline-fueled starfighter combat gameplay with intense portions of hide-and-seek mixed in that veterans of the series and sci-fi fans in general crave.”
DBLTAP

“Coordinating your efforts works on multiple levels, both in terms of ensuring that your ships stay together and can support one another, taking a tactical approach to engaging the enemy, but also within a ship...It’s really satisfying to have it all come together.”
TheSixthAxis
short_description: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.
